top_signals.title: Iran War Pushes Trump's Average Gasoline Prices Above Biden's
top_signals.summary: The average price Americans have paid for gasoline during President Donald Trump's second term has now surpassed the average recorded during Joe Biden's presidency, marking a politically significant milestone just days before the November 3 midterm elections. According to AAA data cited by Reuters, regular gasoline has averaged $3.472 per gallon since Trump returned to office in January 2025, compared with $3.471 during Biden's four-year presidency. The difference is marginal, but it represents a striking reversal for a president who campaigned…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
